landing.faq.description: What you need to know about creating, daily check-ins, referrals and using credits.
landing.faq.quality.question: What can I create on this website?
landing.faq.quality.answer: Enter a prompt on the homepage, choose an aspect ratio, then generate with AI Image. Use the dedicated editor for reference-image changes, and the prompt library for posters, products, typography, infographics and UI concepts.
landing.faq.credits.question: How are credits calculated, and are failed tasks refunded?
landing.faq.credits.answer: Default FLUX.2 generation uses 8 credits per image; editing uses 10 credits. Other models show their own quote before submission.
landing.faq.commercial.question: Can I use generated images commercially?
landing.faq.commercial.answer: Commercial use depends on the selected model, provider terms, your prompt, uploaded materials and the rights of people, brands or characters depicted. Review the current Terms and the relevant provider license before publishing; this website cannot grant rights owned by a provider or third party.
landing.faq.models.question: Which AI models and tools are actually available now?
landing.faq.models.answer: Choose from integrated Nano Banana, GPT Image, Seedream and FLUX models. Each model page shows availability and its credit quote.
landing.faq.release_status.question: Can I generate with Wan 3.0 or Seedance 2.5 here today?
landing.faq.release_status.answer: Alibaba Cloud's Wan 3.0 Preview API is live as wan3.0-video in Beijing, but this site's Wan 3.0 generator is not enabled until a real request and billing flow pass end-to-end testing. Seedance 2.5 remains a prompt builder while paid Seedance generation uses the verified 2.0 endpoint.
landing.faq.account.question: Can I try the workflow before signing in?
landing.faq.account.answer: Yes. You can write a prompt and choose the model and aspect ratio first, then sign in when you generate. Your draft is restored after you return. Examples, guides and prompt-planning tools are also available without signing in. The current new-account reward is shown on the sign-in and sign-up pages.
landing.faq.rewards.question: How do daily check-ins and referral rewards work?
landing.faq.rewards.answer: Signed-in users can check in once per day. A seven-day streak awards 3, 4, 4, 5, 5, 6 and 6 credits, for 33 credits in total; a missed day restarts the streak. Referral links apply to accounts created within the last seven days, and a successful referral gives 10 credits to each person. Duplicate, self-referral and abusive claims are not rewarded.
landing.faq.privacy.question: Are my prompts, uploads and results public?
landing.faq.privacy.answer: They are not displayed publicly by default. Prompts, uploads and results are associated with your account and sent to the configured AI provider when needed to complete a task. Task records may be retained for history, downloads, support and security. Avoid sensitive information and review the Privacy Policy for the full data-handling details.

tools.youtube_thumbnail.section_1_bullet: Name the object, person, place or transformation viewers should notice first.
Keep the thumbnail idea consistent with the video title rather than repeating every word.
tools.youtube_thumbnail.section_2_body: Most impressions are judged at a small size and in a crowded feed. Large shapes, separated values and a short title survive reduction. Fine props, several faces and long sentences usually collapse into visual noise even when the full-resolution image looks impressive.
tools.youtube_thumbnail.section_2_bullet: Zoom the result down until it is roughly the width of a mobile search card.
Reject any result whose focal subject or title needs more than a glance to decode.
tools.youtube_thumbnail.section_3_body: A curiosity gap works when the image shows an unusual state and the video explains it. Fabricated outcomes, fake metrics and unrelated celebrity faces may increase short-term clicks but damage audience trust and can create policy or rights problems.
tools.youtube_thumbnail.section_3_bullet: Show the real question, conflict or before-and-after explored in the video.

tools.video.section_1_body: A video prompt needs verbs and sequence. State the opening condition, the physical change and the final state. Describing only a beautiful subject leaves the model to invent motion, which often produces drifting cameras, unstable geometry or an action that never resolves.
tools.video.section_1_bullet_1: Use a beginning, development and final beat that can fit inside five or eight seconds.
tools.video.section_1_bullet_2: Describe observable movement such as unfolding, turning, rising or crossing the frame.
tools.video.section_2_title: Give the camera one clear job
tools.video.section_2_body: Camera instructions should support the action instead of competing with it. A locked frame reveals transformation; a slow push increases attention; a lateral track follows travel. Stacking orbit, zoom, crane and handheld language in one short clip usually reduces continuity.
tools.video.section_2_bullet_1: Choose one dominant move and a stable subject relationship.
tools.video.section_2_bullet_2: Use a locked or gentle camera when subject accuracy matters more than spectacle.
tools.video.section_3_body: Five seconds suits one reveal, gesture or product moment. Eight seconds gives a two-stage transformation room to breathe. Longer is not automatically better: every additional beat increases cost and creates more opportunities for identity drift or unwanted objects.
tools.video.section_3_bullet_1: Use five seconds for a single shot with one decisive action.
tools.video.section_3_bullet_2: Use eight seconds only when the prompt contains a readable second beat.
tools.video.section_4_body: Watch once for the story, then scrub through the clip for shape changes, duplicate objects, flicker, unsafe details and abrupt camera jumps. tools.video.section_4_bullet_1: Compare the first, middle and final frames for identity and geometry.

tools.video.faq_3_answer: The model must create many temporally consistent frames rather than one image. Queue load and duration affect render time, so the task remains asynchronous and can take several minutes.

homepage_prompt_library.items.night_mono: A streamlined unbranded monorail moves between towers in a rain-dark city at night. The camera tracks alongside as windows cast warm streaks, road reflections slide below, and mist wraps distant buildings. Premium travel futurism, smooth speed, rail hum, rain and quiet traffic.
homepage_prompt_library.items.winter_esc: Point-of-view approach along a snowy forest path toward a warmly lit cabin at blue hour. The camera advances with calm walking motion as fresh snow falls, smoke curls above the roof, and a door opens softly. Inviting travel mood, footsteps, winter wind and fire from inside.
homepage_prompt_library.items.coastal_ro: High drone follow shot of an unbranded compact car traveling along a winding coastal road above the sea. Sun breaks through clouds, waves strike the cliffs, and the vehicle enters alternating light and shadow. Expansive travel commercial, smooth pacing, ocean wind and subtle road sound.
homepage_prompt_library.items.market_wal: Eye-level walk through a lively open-air morning market. Authentic documentary motion, bright natural light, layered voices, footsteps, cookware and street ambience without visible brands.
homepage_prompt_library.items.robot_gard: A small weathered original robot carefully waters flowers in an overgrown greenhouse. Warm hopeful science fiction, servo clicks, water and soft insect ambience.
homepage_prompt_library.items.terrarium_: A miniature futuristic city grows inside a glass terrarium on a dark desk. Macro camera pushes through condensation as tiny transit lights begin moving, rooftop gardens unfold, and clouds form beneath the dome. Photoreal miniature scale, rich depth, delicate machinery and enclosed rain ambience.
homepage_prompt_library.items.orbital_gr: Inside a quiet orbital greenhouse, an astronaut floats between rows of green plants while Earth turns beyond a wide window. The camera drifts weightlessly backward as leaves move in ventilation currents and droplets hover in the air. Realistic space lighting, soft systems hum and radio ambience.
homepage_prompt_library.items.holographi: A vast dark archive awakens as translucent maps and memories rise from hundreds of tables. The camera glides down a central aisle while a lone curator gestures and layers of light reorganize overhead. Elegant restrained science fiction, volumetric blue light, electronic pulses and spacious echoes.
homepage_prompt_library.items.floating_t: A compact aerial tram travels between lush floating islands above a bright sea of clouds. Wide camera follows from behind as waterfalls dissolve into mist and birds cross the route. Believable fantasy engineering, clear daylight, smooth motion, cable vibration, wind and distant water.
homepage_prompt_library.items.clockwork_: A mountain valley built from enormous brass gears begins moving at sunrise. The camera flies low above a river as wheels turn in sequence, bridges unfold, and warm light travels across aged metal. Epic mechanical landscape, detailed scale, rhythmic clicks, deep rotations and flowing water.
homepage_prompt_library.items.paper_drag: A handmade paper dragon wakes on an artist's desk and carefully steps between pencils and folded sketches. Low tabletop camera follows as its wings open, loose paper lifts in the breeze, and a warm lamp flickers. Tactile stop-motion style, playful paper rustle and tiny footsteps.
homepage_prompt_library.items.floating_i: Ancient garden islands float above luminous clouds at sunrise. The camera passes beneath stone arches and rises to reveal waterfalls falling into open sky while trees bend in a gentle breeze. Painterly cinematic fantasy, grand depth, birds, rushing water and airy orchestral atmosphere.
homepage_prompt_library.items.koi_conste: Two watercolor koi circle across a sheet of textured paper. Their painted tails dissolve into points of light, the camera lifts overhead, and the fish swim into a deep night sky as connected constellations. Elegant hand-painted animation, flowing transformation, water brush sounds and delicate chimes.
homepage_prompt_library.items.umbrella_p: Dozens of colorful umbrellas rotate slowly above a narrow courtyard, forming a precise spiral portal. The camera looks straight up and rises toward the center as sunlight flashes between the shapes and ribbons move below. Whimsical practical fantasy, fabric flutter, wind and bright percussive sound.
homepage_prompt_library.items.silk_ribbo: Long translucent silk ribbons move through an empty sunlit space as if sculpted by invisible wind. A locked wide camera watches them weave, separate, and form a brief wave before relaxing. Refined abstract motion, coral and teal palette, soft fabric detail and airy spatial sound.
homepage_prompt_library.items.miniature_: A tiny handcrafted bakery comes alive before dawn. Clay bakers roll dough, a miniature oven glows, and trays move onto wooden shelves as the camera gently pushes through the doorway. Charming stop-motion animation, visible handmade texture, warm light, tiny cookware and cheerful bakery ambience.

seedance_draft.title: Seedance 2.5 Draft Mode
seedance_draft.description: Prepare low-resolution video drafts, compare creative directions and plan one final render without pretending an unverified Draft API is live.
seedance_draft.status_body: The workflow and calculator are available now. Draft generation and Draft-to-Final rendering stay disabled until the provider exposes a verified task-ID upgrade path.
seedance_draft.workspace_title: Plan drafts, compare candidates, then choose
seedance_draft.workspace_description: Set the brief once and preview how a two-stage Seedance workflow will organize references, draft candidates and the selected final render.
seedance_draft.prompt_placeholder: Describe the subject, visible action, camera movement, pacing, dialogue and sound. Keep the goal clear enough to compare multiple drafts.
seedance_draft.references_hint: Choose images, video or audio for local workflow planning
seedance_draft.unavailable_note: No provider request or credit charge occurs on this page while Draft-to-Final access remains unverified.
seedance_draft.comparison_body: The final workflow will support side-by-side playback, selection and a single confirmed final-render action.
seedance_draft.final_body: A verified integration must reuse the provider draft task ID and preserve the prompt, references, seed, ratio and duration.
seedance_draft.calculator_title: Estimate Draft Mode costs before generating
seedance_draft.calculator_body: Adjust the duration, number of drafts, usual full-quality attempts and provider rates. This planning tool does not quote checkout pricing.
seedance_draft.estimate_note: Editable example rates are provided for planning only. Actual credits and provider pricing will be shown before any paid request when the integration is verified.
seedance_draft.how_title: How Seedance 2.5 Draft Mode should work
seedance_draft.how_description: The two-stage workflow separates inexpensive creative review from the final-quality render, while keeping task ownership and billing explicit.
seedance_draft.step_1_body: Enter the prompt, references, duration and aspect ratio once so every candidate starts from the same direction.
seedance_draft.step_2_body: Create a small batch of low-resolution drafts and inspect motion, dialogue, sound and camera timing.
seedance_draft.step_3_body: Review candidates side by side and explicitly select the one task that should continue to final rendering.
seedance_draft.step_4_body: See the final price, confirm once and render from the selected provider draft task instead of drawing a new random result.
seedance_draft.trust_title: No hidden generation or misleading status
seedance_draft.trust_body: The page distinguishes a prepared workflow from a live model connection. The paid controls remain closed until the provider contract and output are verified.
seedance_draft.trust_1: Draft and final actions will require separate price confirmation.
seedance_draft.trust_2: A final task must belong to the same user as its selected draft.
seedance_draft.trust_3: Retries will use idempotency protection to prevent duplicate charges.
seedance_draft.trust_4: Failed provider tasks will retain a specific reason and follow the existing credit-refund rules.
seedance_draft.faq_1_question: Is Seedance 2.5 Draft Mode live on this site?
seedance_draft.faq_1_answer: Not yet. The workflow planner and cost calculator are usable, but generation stays disabled until a provider supports a verified Draft task ID to final-render request.
seedance_draft.faq_2_question: Does this page generate a normal 480p video and call it a Draft?
seedance_draft.faq_2_answer: No. A normal low-resolution generation is not presented as official Draft Mode because it may not be reusable for a deterministic final render.
seedance_draft.faq_3_question: Are the savings shown here guaranteed?
seedance_draft.faq_3_answer: No. The calculator uses editable inputs. Actual savings depend on provider prices, duration, aspect ratio, candidate count and how many full-quality retries you would otherwise make.
seedance_draft.faq_4_question: Can I still use the regular Seedance 2.5 generator?
seedance_draft.faq_4_answer: Yes. The existing Seedance 2.5 generator remains available as a separate single-stage workflow and is not replaced by this preview page.

keyword.pixel.section_1_title: How this pixel art generator works
keyword.pixel.section_1_body: An upload is sampled onto a small grid in your browser. Text mode first calls the site's existing image model, then applies the same grid conversion. The image is enlarged with nearest-neighbor rendering.
keyword.pixel.section_2_body: A smaller grid creates chunkier forms; a larger grid keeps detail. Lower color levels make flatter shapes. Both controls change the exported pixels, not just a preview filter.
keyword.pixel.section_3_body: The result is a PNG, not an animation or tile map. Source transparency is retained where possible. Complex photos may need manual cleanup. Text mode uses the displayed image-generation credits.

keyword.pixel.faq_2_answer: Yes. The AI image costs credits; pixel conversion adds no charge.
keyword.pixel.faq_3_answer: Yes. Export uses nearest-neighbor enlargement for square edges.

keyword.prompt.section_1_title: What the local image-to-prompt draft uses
